title: Page 2
content_zh:
这当中最让他齿冷的就是他们称为世交的邻居——
叶伯伯老是称赞他多么聪明优秀，总说他是他女儿的救命恩人，两家要做永远的朋友……
结果最翻脸不认人的就是他，不仅仅没有出手帮助，还在那时候抽银根，以银行需要保障资产为由，声请查封了他的家。
他永远没有办法忘记那一天，他从学校回家，两人……
「很久没来了，很怀念吧！这附近改变不大，还是你小时候的样子。」
热情的招呼声传进耳中，将苏劲沧的注意力拉回现实。
他清冷的目光缓缓落在一旁的中年男子身上。
「是啊，叶伯伯。」
淡淡的附和不带什么情绪，但叶金富的心却不由得一震。那是种奇妙的感觉，虽然再次见面，苏劲沧提都没有提过去的事情，可是他有种一闪而过的错觉，感到他用批判的眼神瞪着他。
是他多心了吧？
那时候他还小，应该不知道他跟他父母间的事情。
其实说起来，他也没做错什么不是吗？个人有个人的立场，他是银行的董事，总不能因为一点私人交情就把银行的利益置于不顾吧？谁叫苏永正那么没用，一个中毒意外就把公司赔掉了。
嗯，苏劲沧应该了解才对。
毕竟他现在已经是一家极有前景的电子公司老板，对商场上的事情应该能够理解。
说起来他还真是了不起，短短的十年间就白手起家，创办出比当初他父亲公司规模还大的企业。
虽说他以前就是个优秀聪明的孩子，可是现在光是站着就给人一种强烈的压迫感，甚至不用说话，只是一记眼神，就让人不由得屈服在他的意志之下。
那是属于王者的气势，并不是任何人身上都可见的特质。此外他还有聪明的头脑、敏锐的洞悉力，以及坚毅的自信，那是所有成功企业家需具备的要件。
如果他看人的眼光没错的话，这个苏劲沧绝对不简单，以后的发展更是前途无量，他可要跟他打好关系才行。
叶金富脑中如意算盘打得响亮，嘴上可也没闲着，「快进来吧！你叶伯母听我说今天会邀请你来家里，从早上就很兴奋的张罗，说要煮一桌丰盛的请你呢！还有啊，我们家欢欢也高兴得不得了。你记得欢欢吧？她从小就爱黏着你，你搬走以后她还哭了好一阵子吶！」
苏劲沧微微挑眉，那是他脸上唯一出现的小小波动。

那个叫欢欢的女孩他还记得。
印象中最深刻的就是一双充满迷恋、崇拜，仰望着他的眼睛，每次回头就会看见。她老爱黏着他，从幼儿园流着鼻涕的小鬼到半大不小的国中女生。他没给过她什么好脸色，只觉得她烦，可就是赶不走她。
习惯是种恐怖的东西，离开之后他有很久的一段时间都还会偶尔回头，然后会因为没看见那个总是会出现的身影，而觉得哪里怪怪的……
轻斥自己无聊的思绪，苏劲沧再次戴上没有任何破绽的面具，淡淡的微笑。
「我也很期待见到她们。」他的声音里除了礼貌的淡漠，找不到任何一丁点的感情。
叶咏欢又作了相同的梦。
「等我嘛！」
她都快哭出来了，可是前方穿着高中制服的少年理都不理她。
「别……走那么快，等、等我……」
她跑得有点上气不接下气了。没办法，她的腿又不像他那么长，他走一步她就得走两步，偏偏他又一点放慢速度等她跟上来的意愿都没有。
她眼前一黑，晕眩感袭来。都怪她平常不爱运动，跑这么一小段路就让她头晕目眩，喘不过气。
在感觉自己就要晕倒时，她突然撞上一面厚墙。
呃……其实不是墙，而是一面跟墙一样硬的胸膛，手上传来的疼痛让她稍稍清醒了点，抬起头，立刻对上少年不耐烦的眼睛。
「跟着我干么？坐妳家的车回去！」
小小的头颅摇得像波浪鼓一样。「不要！我想跟你一起用走的。」
苏劲沧脸色一沉。
「随便妳。」
他又转身往前走，虽然还是没有理她，可是她心里觉得一阵振奋。
他没有赶她回去了不是吗？那就是说他同意她跟在身边喽？呵，好幸福啊！
她没有时间高兴太久，一回神，发现他走得好快，就快要看不见了，她连忙追上去。

苏劲沧走进一家大型书店，在想要买的参考书前遇到他的同班同学。
「苏劲沧！」穿着高一制服的女孩有张清秀漂亮的脸蛋，年轻却傲人的身材，看见了他，露出高兴的表情。
叶咏欢瞇起眼睛，全身的细胞都发出警戒的讯号，就像一只被入侵领土的小狗竖起了毛。
苏劲沧看到那女孩，弯起嘴角，露出笑容。「妳也来买书？」
「嗯，想找找今天老师推荐的那本书，叫什么来着？」
「在这里。」
身高一八五的苏劲沧伸手就拿到书架上最高的那本书，递给了女孩。
叶咏欢看着两人谈笑的模样，不自觉的捏紧小拳头。
嫉妒、羡慕、委屈……各种丑陋的感觉在她胸口滞闷。他从来就没有用那种温柔的眼神看过她，更别提那种暖暖的笑容了……
「买好书以后妳要去哪？回家吗？」
「也不急着回家。」
「那我们去吃点东西吧？好吗？」
女孩听到苏劲沧的话宛如中了乐透一样，整张脸红了起来，显然从来没有想过这么幸运的事情会降临在自己身上。
「好啊、好啊！」
叶咏欢不可置信的瞪大眼。
苏大哥要跟别的女孩子去吃东西？可、可是她怎么办？他不是知道她跟着他吗？怎么会这样？
她跟在他们后面走，用很着急的眼睛看着他，可他就算看见她快哭出来的表情也完全不在乎，他像不觉得身后有人一样，把她彻底当成空气，越走越快、越走越快……
她抽着鼻子，感觉到伤心，边走，眼泪边扑簌簌的往下流，眼前的路模糊成一片。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
低下头抹了抹眼泪，再抬起头，却看不见他的身影了。

她惶然的找着，夜晚的街道车水马龙，路上行人如织，就是找不到她想见的那个人。她慌了、乱了方寸。
眼里一直只有一个目标，除了那人再看不到别的东西，而今那个人不见了，她才发现她连自己在哪里、该怎么回家都不知道。
「小妹妹，怎么了？怎么一个人啊？迷路了？不想回家？要不要叔叔带妳去玩？」
在耳边出现的声音让她停止哭泣，抬头看向声音的来源。旁边站着的猥琐中年男子带着邪恶的笑容，她出于本能退了一步，可是那人竟然又黏了上来，她全身鸡皮疙瘩都起来了。
「你、你走开！」
「不要怕嘛！我只是想跟妳做个朋友而已。」
中年男子的靠近带来浓浓的酒臭味，她都快吐了，可是左躲右躲却躲不开男子的纠缠。正当她急得要大哭时，一个像山一样高大的身影出现在男子的身后，一只大掌的一声重重的打在男子肩上。
「干什么？」
中年男子回头，正要发火，看见对方是身材体格都优于自己许多的少年，再看见对方那跟年龄不相符的严峻双眼，一下子就宛如泄气的皮球般缩了缩身子，爆了声粗口，急急忙忙的跑掉了。
「苏大哥……」她兴奋又崇拜的抬眼看他。
content_en:
The most chilling thing among them was the neighbor they called their family friend——
Uncle Ye always praised him for how smart and outstanding he was, and always said that he was his daughter's savior and that the two families should be friends forever...
In the end, he was the one who turned his back the most. Not only did he not help, but he also took out money at that time. On the grounds that the bank needed to protect its assets, he petitioned to seal up his home.
He could never forget that day when he came home from school and the two of them...
"It's been a long time since I've been here. I miss you so much! Not much has changed around here. It's still the same as when you were a kid."
The warm greeting reached his ears, bringing Su Jincang's attention back to reality.
His cold eyes slowly fell on the middle-aged man beside him.
"Yes, Uncle Ye."
There was no emotion in the faint agreement, but Ye Jinfu's heart couldn't help but tremble. It was a wonderful feeling. Although Su Jincang didn't mention the past when they met again, he had a fleeting illusion that he was glaring at him with critical eyes.
Is he too worried?
He was still young at that time and probably didn't know what happened between him and his parents.
In fact, speaking of it, he didn't do anything wrong, right? An individual has his or her own position. He is a director of a bank. He cannot disregard the interests of the bank just because of some personal relationship, right? Who said Su Yongzheng was so useless that he lost the company due to a poisoning accident?
Well, Su Jincang should understand.
After all, he is now the owner of a very promising electronics company, and he should be able to understand things in the mall.
Speaking of which, he is really amazing. In just ten years, he started from scratch and established a company that is larger than his father's company.
Although he used to be an excellent and smart child, now he gives people a strong sense of oppression just by standing there. Even without speaking, just a look can make people succumb to his will.
That is the aura of a king, and it is not a trait that can be seen in anyone. In addition, he has a smart mind, keen insights, and strong self-confidence, which are the requirements for all successful entrepreneurs.
If his vision of people is correct, this Su Jincang is definitely not simple, and his future development is even more promising. He must have a good relationship with him.
Ye Jinfu's wishful thinking was loud in his mind, and he was not idle, "Come in! Your Aunt Ye heard that I would invite you to my home today. She has been very excited since the morning and said she would cook a sumptuous table for you! Also, our family Huanhuan is also very happy. You remember Huanhuan, right? She has loved to cling to you since she was a child, and she cried for a while after you moved away!"
Su Jincang raised his eyebrows slightly, which was the only small fluctuation on his face.
He still remembered the girl named Huanhuan.
The most profound thing that impressed me was a pair of eyes full of fascination and adoration, looking up at him, which I would see every time I looked back. She always loved to cling to him, from a kid with a runny nose in kindergarten to a half-grown junior high school girl. He never gave her a good look, he just found her annoying, but he couldn't drive her away.
Habits are scary things. He would occasionally look back for a long time after leaving, and then he would feel something was strange because he didn't see the figure that always appeared...
Scolding his boring thoughts, Su Jincang once again put on the flawless mask and smiled lightly.
"I'm looking forward to meeting them too." Apart from polite indifference, there was no trace of emotion in his voice.
Ye Yonghuan had the same dream again.
"Wait for me!"
She almost cried, but the young man in high school uniform in front of her ignored her.
"Don't... walk so fast, wait, wait for me..."
She was running a little out of breath. There was no way, her legs were not as long as his, so she had to take two steps when he took one step, but he slowed down a little and waited for her to catch up.There is no intention to come.
Her vision went dark and she felt dizzy. It's all because she doesn't like to exercise. Running for such a short distance makes her dizzy and out of breath.
Just when she felt like she was about to faint, she suddenly hit a thick wall.
Well... it was actually not a wall, but a chest as hard as the wall. The pain from her hand made her wake up a little. She raised her head and immediately met the boy's impatient eyes.
"Why are you following me? Take your car back!"
The little head shook like a wavy drum. "No! I want to walk with you."
Su Jincang's face darkened.
"Whatever you want."
He turned around and walked forward again. Although he still ignored her, she felt excited in her heart.
He didn't drive her back, right? Does that mean he agrees to have her by his side? Oh, so happy!
She didn't have time to be happy for too long. When she came to her senses, she found that he was walking so fast that he was almost out of sight, so she quickly caught up with him.
Su Jincang walked into a large bookstore and met his classmate in front of the reference book he wanted to buy.
"Su Jincang!" The girl in the freshman uniform had a pretty face and a young but proud figure. When she saw him, she showed a happy expression.
Ye Yonghuan narrowed his eyes, and all the cells in his body sent out alert signals, like a puppy whose territory had been invaded and its fur was bristling.
When Su Jincang saw the girl, he curved his lips and smiled. "Are you here to buy books too?"
"Well, I'm looking for the book that the teacher recommended today. What is it called?"
"Here."
Su Jincang, who was 185cm tall, reached out and picked up the tallest book on the bookshelf and handed it to the girl.
Ye Yonghuan watched the two of them talking and laughing, and clenched her fists unconsciously.
Jealousy, envy, grievance...all kinds of ugly feelings were stagnant in her chest. He had never looked at her with such gentle eyes, let alone that warm smile...
"Where are you going after buying the book? Going home?"
"I'm not in a hurry to go home."
"Then let's go get something to eat? Okay?"
When the girl heard Su Jincang's words, she felt as if she had won the lottery. Her whole face turned red. It was obvious that she had never thought that such a lucky thing would happen to her.
"Okay, okay!"
Ye Yonghuan's eyes widened in disbelief.
Brother Su wants to go eat with other girls? But, what should she do? Didn't he know that she was following him? how so?
She walked behind them, looking at him with anxious eyes, but he didn't care at all even if he saw her expression about to cry. As if he didn't feel that there was anyone behind him, he completely regarded her as air, walking faster and faster, faster and faster...
She sniffed and felt sad. As she walked, tears flowed down her face, and the road in front of her became blurry.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
He lowered his head and wiped his tears, then raised his head again, but he could no longer be seen.
She searched anxiously. The streets at night were busy with traffic and pedestrians, but she couldn't find the person she wanted to see. She panicked and became confused.
There was always only one target in her eyes, and she couldn't see anything else except that person. Now that that person was gone, she realized that she didn't even know where she was or how to get home.
"Little sister, what's wrong? Why are you alone? Are you lost? Don't want to go home? Do you want uncle to take you to play?"
The sound in her ears made her stop crying and look up at the source of the sound. The wretched middle-aged man standing next to her had an evil smile. She took a step back out of instinct, but the man came back and she got goosebumps all over her body.
"You, you go away!"
"Don't be afraid! I just want to be your friend."
The middle-aged man's approach brought with it a strong smell of alcohol, and she almost vomited, but she could not avoid the man's entanglement as she ducked left and right. Just when she was so anxious that she was about to cry, a man like a mountainA tall figure appeared behind the man, and a big palm hit the man's shoulder hard.
"What?"
The middle-aged man turned around and was about to get angry when he saw that the other person was a young man who was much better than him in body and physique. Then he saw the other person's stern eyes that were inconsistent with his age. He shrunk like a frustrated ball, swore and ran away in a hurry.
"Brother Su..." She looked up at him with excitement and admiration.
